note.question: How do region-level requirements increase the size of an already difficult (NP-hard) problem substantially, making adaptations of existing approaches impractical?
note.overview: Although retailers recognize the potential value of sharing transactional data with supply chain partners, many remain reluctant to share. However, there is evidence that the extent of sharing would be greater if information sensitive to retailers can be concealed before sharing. Extant research has only considered sensitive information at the organizational level.
